translations.web: In praying, don’t use vain repetitions, as the Gentiles do; for they think that they will be heard for their much speaking.
translations.bsb: And when you pray, do not babble on like pagans, for they think that by their many words they will be heard.
translations.kjv: But when ye pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.
translations.asv: And in praying use not vain repetitions, as the Gentiles do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.
